tasks.short: Program computers for biological data analysis

steps.what: Define data mappings, analysis questions and tests before programming computers
Write code to store, process and analyze the specified data

loop.purpose: Draft analysis code within the supplied specification
loop.input: Mappings, analysis requirements and known test examples
loop.check: Compare transformations and statistical choices with the intended biology, then inspect known-result tests
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unsupported operations are coded manually
loop.why_not_simpler: New analyses require contextual code composition; established routines should be reused first

steps.what: Validate code, run analysis and interpret biological results

tasks.design: Reuse native routines in {DATA_PLATFORM} first, then use a bounded code-drafting loop for the remaining implementation. The biologist checks transformations and tests before running code on the study data and interpreting its results.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing new transformations consumed time even when requirements were explicit.
tasks.enabler_now: Code drafting can produce inspectable candidates within a controlled workspace.
tasks.still_hard: A passing program may implement an unsuitable biological or statistical assumption.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist decides whether an analysis answers the research question.
tasks.altitude: Some implementation time shifts to validating the biological meaning of transformations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded code assistance can draft transformations, but the proposed saving requires local measurement.

assumptions: Boundary is programming and using an analysis, excluding original sample collection and separate report writing.

The biologist creates s1 mappings with dataset version, identifiers, variable types, units, exclusions, intended calculations and expected test results. Capture and scientific specification remain fully counted; missing definitions are resolved manually before code generation.
Test existing platform libraries and reusable jobs before custom code or a model call; compute runtime earns no labour saving.
Six incremental focal hours cover test and dependency upkeep.
unknowns: Current programming skill and reusable routines
research_questions: Does checked candidate code reduce total implementation time without changing results or scientific assumptions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R89.5 gives10.5 gross minus6 upkeep =4.5 net. Novel analyses needing substantial rewrites or already reusable code support only0-2% conservative saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and explain biological research reports

steps.what: Select report findings, supporting evidence and limitations for the intended audience
Prepare technical and research report prose from the evidence brief

loop.purpose: Draft a report with traceable findings and explicit limitations
loop.check: Verify conclusions, uncertainty and audience wording against the actual study evidence
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unresolved sections return to manual authorship
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining research findings requires contextual prose beyond fixed headings

steps.what: Finalize the report and communicate results to industry, government or public audiences

tasks.design: Use the existing {DOCS} template and a bounded writing loop on the biologist's evidence brief. The biologist checks the meaning, finalizes the exact report and explains the findings personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning checked results into audience-specific prose required repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound document drafting can supply a provisional narrative.
tasks.still_hard: Environmental implications and uncertainty can be distorted by apparently clear wording.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist decides what the evidence supports and handles questions about its limits.
tasks.altitude: Limited drafting time returns to assessing uncertainty and explaining consequences.

reach.role: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
reach.task: Explain biological evidence in an environmental assessment

evidence.claim: Benchling AI drafts study reports; this supports report assistance, not automatic environmental conclusions or a measured local saving.
Model knowledge: the proposed checked-drafting saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary starts with validated results and ends with report communication; analysis labour is owned separately and not counted again.

The biologist produces s1 evidence with result versions, source passages, figures, units, limitations, required sections and audience. Capture and checking stay counted. Missing evidence is obtained manually or explicitly left unresolved.
Test native document templates and report features before custom drafting; no model publishes results.
Five incremental focal hours cover template and source-instruction maintenance.
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce total report preparation while preserving the study's limitations?

incremental.description: Maintain report template and evidence instructions

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report, figures, limitations, recipient and release channel; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R89.5 gives10.5 gross minus5 upkeep =5.5 net. Reports requiring extensive scientific rewrites or long stakeholder discussions reduce conservative saving to0-2%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supervise biological technicians and scientists, resolving priorities and coaching research practice

tasks.design: Keep supervision personal and use existing {PROJECT} records for context. The biologist observes research practice, resolves competing priorities and coaches staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff needs and experimental setbacks emerge through conversation and observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing project information supports context without replacing supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Judging capability, safety and appropriate intervention depends on the situation.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor builds trust and recognizes when someone needs help.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in supervisory responsibility or assumed time.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive scientific supervision remains human work; no saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers the biologist's supervision, excluding staff execution time and separately owned project reporting.
The biologist gathers context and records directions during fully counted s1; no structured performance flag substitutes for observation.
Use existing project records before custom supervisory automation.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool or mandatory reporting process is introduced.
research_questions: Is any distinct clerical overhead measurable without reducing coaching and observation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 net0 with zero upkeep. Routine supervision and difficult staff situations retain human time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop working relations and discuss cooperative management strategies and research findings

tasks.design: Maintain direct liaison using existing {EMAIL} and {CALENDAR} support. The biologist listens to concerns, interprets findings and negotiates workable cooperation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cooperation depends on trust and differing interests rather than missing software.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication tools provide access but do not replace relationship work.
tasks.still_hard: Stakeholders may disagree about evidence, responsibilities or acceptable outcomes.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognizes unstated concerns and earns credibility over time.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in liaison responsibilities or assumed relationship time.

reach.task: Discuss cooperative management priorities with local groups

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: liaison and cooperative relationships retain human time in this design.

assumptions: Boundary covers relationship development and cooperative discussions, excluding separately owned report authorship and implementation of agreements.
The biologist elicits stakeholder concerns and checks the relevant findings during counted s1; responses are not presumed available before contact.
Use native communication and calendar functions before considering custom software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or recurring data capture is proposed.
unknowns: Frequency and difficulty of cooperation discussions
research_questions: Is there measurable scheduling overhead distinct from the relationship work?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Established partnerships and contested management discussions both retain human liaison time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Limited code and report assistance creates time for scientific validation while supervision and external relationships stay personal.
reach: Help bioinformatics colleagues specify reproducible analyses
Explain biological findings in environmental and conservation discussions
role.ambitious_version: A biologist with reproducible analyses and clear reports who remains directly accountable to staff and stakeholders.
